rationale: The pathway is delivered by practices and the triage line, so allocation must be at practice level to avoid contamination; a cluster randomised trial with 11 practices stratified by size and deprivation, using routine coded data, answers whether prescribing falls without harm. The retrieved trial supports a plausible effect (c1) and no signal of harm (c2); antibiotics add nothing when dental treatment is given (c3); GPs ask for exactly this support (c4).
alternatives: Before-after comparison across the network (refused: prescribing is falling nationally, so secular trends would be confounded)
Individually randomised trial (refused: GPs cannot use and not use the pathway with different patients)
Stepped-wedge design (refused: the triage line runs only 12 months)
guidelines: CONSORT extension for cluster randomised trials
whyNotMoreComplex: A multi-network trial would need funding and a longer triage line; the network's 11 practices answer the question with stated uncertainty.

decision.statement: Run a 12-month cluster randomised trial of the dental pain pathway in the network's 11 practices, stratified by practice size and deprivation, with antibiotic prescribing as the primary outcome and emergency attendance for dental infection as a balancing measure.
decision.question: Should the network test the dental pain pathway in a cluster randomised trial?

criteria.text: A decision aid with dental advice reduced prescribing without more admissions in a cluster randomised trial.
The triage line cannot be staffed for 12 months.

gates.requirement: Community dental service agreement to run the triage line for 12 months
gates.evidence: Letter CDS-2026-17 dated 2026-09-09, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Research ethics committee decision on waiving individual patient consent for allocation at practice level
Monthly extraction of coded consultations and prescriptions by the network data team
gates.evidence: Network data team capability stated in the investigator's local facts (one clinical system, monthly extraction)

alternatives: Decision aid alone without the triage line
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c4 from retrieved records; the consent-waiver gate stays unknown until the ethics committee decides, so the action is blocked.

summary: Cluster randomised trial recommended; the decision rests on four ledger claims and one gate is unknown.
